name: held-gizmo
description: ▶ WATCH THE TRAILER: https://spawn.co/cdn/value.29047d39ebe1e99fe5a8c178c0b22fd9b857aada052e3028d1774970467f306e.mp4 · ⚡ FeelsGoodRig ⚡ NEW: COPY HOLD → PLAYERS hands a character's gun grip to every player holding that gun (rigs with no finger bones copy as a palm cradle) · pose any rigged character in god mode: NEW: pick the BODY (shows the character's name) to slide and turn the whole character while held items like a zipline handle stay put (glasses and hats ride along), SAVE keeps the spot · move what they hold, pose each hand and finger per animation, pin either hand to a held item so the arm follows it, NEW: 📌 PIN TO CHEST holds any item right where it stands so it bends and moves with the body (UNPIN puts it back), freeze in any clip, mirror, reset a hand or just its arm, undo. · TIP for gun sway that keeps hands on the grips: parent the gun to the chest bone (Spine2), pin both hands to its grips, turn off the gun's smoothing (interpolation: null), and pivot small walk-scaled sway on the trigger grip. TIP for matching poses: add a dev-only freeze key (P) that holds your player on the idle's first frame, no sway, so you and the dummy stand on the same frame.
